title: feat(rest)!: retire GET {base}/docs, the OpenAPI document's HTML viewer page; /openapi.json stays
body:
Fixes #25104

Clause-②: no (narrowing)
Metadata-protocol: none

## What and why

`GET {base}/docs`, the HTML viewer page for the OpenAPI document, is retired on both route shapes: the unscoped `{base}/docs` and the environment-scoped `{base}/environments/:environmentId/docs`. Nothing read it, and the API origin serves no HTML viewer. This is the maintainer's choice on the card, 「C 下线页面」.

`GET {base}/openapi.json`, its `api.enableOpenApi` gate and its answer stay. The dispatcher's security-header defaults are not touched.

## Contract

Every input whose answer changes, old → new. Measured on this branch's build (`packages/rest/dist` carries 0 viewer markers and 1 `openapi.json` registration). Hosts were booted with REST and dispatcher project scoping on, as `serve.ts` forwards it.

| Input | Old | New |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `GET {base}/docs`, signed-in caller, `plugin-hono-server` | 200 `text/html`, the viewer page | 404 `application/json`, `{"success":false,"error":{"code":"ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND","message":"Not found"}}` |
| `GET {base}/docs`, anonymous caller, `plugin-hono-server` | 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED` | the same 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` |
| `GET {base}/environments/:environmentId/docs`, signed-in and anonymous, `plugin-hono-server` | 200 page / 401 | the same 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND` |
| both `/docs` shapes, signed-in and anonymous, node `IHttpServer` (the private conformance adapter) | 200 page / 401 | 404 `ENDPOINT_NOT_FOUND`, the same body |
| `GET /api/v1/docs` on a booted showcase (dogfood `bootStack`), anonymous and member | 401 / 200 page | 404, byte-identical to the body a never-served path gets on that boot |
| `GET {base}/docs` with a session held by an auth policy, or during a permission-store outage | that policy's 403 / 503 | no handler exists, so the host's not-found applies. Not measured separately on a host. |
| `paths` of `GET {base}/openapi.json` (both shapes) | lists `{base}/docs` | does not list it |
| `api.enableOpenApi: false` | unmounts 2 routes | unmounts 1 route, the document |
| `RestServer.getRoutes()` | one `GET {base}/docs` per mounted base | none |

**Unchanged, measured on both RestServer hosts and both shapes:** `GET {base}/openapi.json` answers a signed-in caller 200 with the OpenAPI 3.1 document and an anonymous caller 401 `UNAUTHENTICATED`. A path that was never served answers the same 404 body as the retired path. `@objectstack/hono`'s `createHonoApp` mounts no RestServer route. It answers 404 `ROUTE_NOT_FOUND` on `/docs`, on `/openapi.json` and on a never-served path, as it did before this change.

## The pins

**New: `packages/rest/src/rest-docs-viewer-retired.pin.test.ts`.** It asserts the following on both route shapes:
- `{base}/docs` has no registration: none in `getRoutes()`, none in the route manager under any verb, and no path handed to the host `IHttpServer`.
- `{base}/openapi.json` is still registered on the server and on the host.
- The served document is the OpenAPI 3.1 body. As a control it lists its own `openapi.json` path, and it lists no `/docs` path.

Red on the base tree `f2b6cf230b` with only the pin added (commit `5fb3bdb3f0`): `Tests 4 failed | 2 passed (6)`. The four not-served and not-described cases fail; the two kept-document cases pass. Green after the retirement: 6/6.

**Updated: what each asserted before, and what it asserts now.** No assertion that is still true was loosened.
- `rest-api-description-anonymous-deny.test.ts`
  - Before: two endpoints × two bases. Anonymous 401 for the document and the viewer, the viewer's 401 body byte-identical to `/data`'s, the signed-in viewer serving HTML pointed at its sibling document, the document describing both endpoints, and the gated-session 403 and outage 503 on both endpoints.
  - Now: the document only, on both bases, with every document assertion unchanged. The viewer cases left with the viewer, and the new pin holds its absence.
- `rest-config-mount-table.pin.test.ts`: the `api.enableOpenApi` row went from removing `GET /api/v1/docs` and `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` to removing `GET /api/v1/openapi.json` alone. The table still has 20 switches.
- `rest-api-config-dead-keys-refused.test.ts`
  - Before: the default mounts both routes the switch owns, and `false` removes exactly both.
  - Now: the default mounts the document, and `false` removes exactly it.
- `rest-route-ledger.ts` and its conformance test: the `GET /api/v1/docs` row is removed. The conformance test is unchanged. It still asserts that the ledger and the mounted routes match in both directions, and it went red in the retirement ablation only because the row named a route that was no longer mounted.
- `execctx-consumer-census.test.ts`: sites 62 → 61, mentions 145 → 144, bare 46 → 45, caught unchanged at 16. The §3 floor `rows ≥ 46` stays at 46: 51 rows were measured after the retirement, so the old floor still holds and is not lowered.
- `html-outlets.pin.test.ts` (from PR #25093)
  - The outlet list goes from `discovery-routes.ts` to empty.
  - The non-outlet list drops `html-escape.ts` (retired) and `rest-route-ledger.ts`, whose only HTML-touching string was the viewer row's note. It keeps `import-template.ts`.
  - The census is unchanged.
  - The positive control used to read `discovery-routes.ts` from disk. It now runs the census over this package's tree plus a fixture source shaped like the retired page, and asserts that the census finds the fixture and that the fixture is exactly the one unclassified file.

**Beyond the measured starting map: `packages/qa/dogfood`.** Main's full battery runs these files; PR CI does not. Without these edits they would go red on `main` after the merge:
- `authz-probe-blind-spot.census.ts`
  - Ledger row: 81 / 81 / 0 → 80 / 80 / 0.
  - `rest-server.ts` row: 70 / 19 / 51 → 69 / 19 / 50. Controls: `this.routeManager.register(` 63 → 62, `discovery-routes.ts` 4 → 3, `enforceAuth` 112 → 111.
  - Totals: 65 / 70 → 64 / 69.
  - All numbers re-derived by its own `deriveProbeFileCensus()`.
- `authz-conformance.matrix.ts`: the `anonymous-deny-api-description` row now covers the one route left, and the docblock's ledger figure goes from 81 to 80 rows, which its pin reads.
- `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces.dogfood.test.ts`: the viewer row and its 200 member control are replaced by a retired-path case. It asserts 404 for both the anonymous caller and the member, with a body equal to that of a never-served path.

## Also in this change

- `packages/rest/src/html-escape.ts` is retired with its only caller. `git grep escapeHtml` over `packages/rest` finds no other caller. The repo's other escaper is private to `plugin-email`.
- Comments that described the page are updated in `discovery-routes.ts`, `rest-server.ts`, `openapi-builtin-paths.ts` and `rest-route-ledger.ts`. The ADR anchor `scripts/adr-anchors/packages__rest__src__discovery-routes.ts.json` now names the one API-description door left.
- QA checklist `access-security.anonymous-floor-v18-doors` goes to revision 3. `/docs` leaves the floored-door step, and a new step and clause drive the retired path to the host's ordinary 404, following the file's revision and history convention.
- The changeset for `@objectstack/rest` is `patch`, because this is a non-protocol change (`Metadata-protocol: none`), and keeps its BREAKING banner and its ADR-0087 `not-required (no-migration-prescription)` disposition.

## Not in this change

- The `packages/spec` text that names the viewer belongs to `domain:spec`'s #25121, which is blocked by this card. That text is the `api.enableOpenApi` describe and the `api.documentation.enabled` tombstone prescription in `rest-server.zod.ts`. Further `packages/spec` sites, seen by grep and left for that card: the `liveness/rest_api.json` evidence line, `scripts/lib/openapi-self-consistency.ts` (a comment and a refusal message) and the prose in `migrations/entries/semantic/18.rest-api-config-dead-keys-retired.ts`. The generated `content/docs/references/api/rest-server.mdx` follows that card's regeneration.
- `/openapi.json`'s gate and shape, the dispatcher's security-header defaults, and the export/import files are untouched.

## Verification (code at `1379d30df4`, a merge of `origin/main` `edcc8ceae6`; the head `520df1bfa6` adds only the changeset-level fix above it)

- `@objectstack/rest` local project, run at the pre-merge head `b55b8f782d`: `Test Files 312 passed (312)`, `Tests 6185 passed | 326 skipped (6511)`. The merge brought one `packages/spec` describe-text commit only, so it was not re-run.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck` exit 0 (`tsc --noEmit` plus `check:test-typecheck`). `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood typecheck` exit 0. Both programs list the edited test files.
- dogfood, run once on the final head: `authz-probe-blind-spot.test.ts` and `authz-conformance.test.ts` 108/108; `showcase-anonymous-deny-surfaces.dogfood.test.ts` 74/74, including the new retired-path case.
- `@objectstack/spec` was rebuilt after the merge. `check:generated` reports all 14 artifacts up to date.
- Gates: `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `1379d30df4` derived 86 commands. All 86 were run, plus the 10 families listed under "Declared WIDE population", and every one exited 0. `check:dual-build-cjs-loads` first answered PREREQUISITE NOT MET because 8 unrelated packages had no `dist`; it was re-run after building them (all turbo cache hits) and exited 0. Reconciliation: `✓ dispatch-gates --ran: 86 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 86 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED (a DERIVED zero — all 86 recorded an exit code and none of them is 3).`
- `pnpm lint`: exit 0 on `1379d30df4` (`eslint . --no-inline-config`, the whole tree).

## Acceptance notes

- NOT MEASURED: the new dogfood retired-path case against `main`. Its red direction follows from main serving `/docs` with 401 to an anonymous caller and 200 to a member, which this file asserted until now.
- This narrowing owes one `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` review of record before the queue, as the claim states.
